profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
Full Stack Software Engineer with a special love for the web.

Working at Meta as a SWE on the Code Review team.

Worked at Pinterest as a SWE 2 on the Billing team, at Kueski Pay (mexican fintech startup).
Did 5 Software Engineer internships; 4 at Meta (Messenger, Facebook) and ML intern with Microsoft.
Got a B.Sc. in Computers Systems Engineering at IPN and a B.Sc. in CS at UNAM.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on the Code Review team, improving Phabricator to make Meta's developers more efficient.
Making Phabricator/Diffs a joyful experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Engineering · JavaScript · PHP · SQL · React

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Collaborator on Ads Core Billing.

• Worked on creating the fully new Pinterest's Invoice Management System
• Improve UX on the Pinterest Billing Page around Payment Settings; revamped the prepayment flow
• Worked to implement Chile DTT changes to Pinterest tax systems
positions.insights: Skills: cypress · Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Java · Git · React · CSS · Front-End Development · flow

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Collaborator on Nonprofits team at Central Social Impact

• Improved nonprofits experience on Nonprofit Manager by allowing to save filters for supporter lists
• Improved and created new system for notification cards shown in the main feed of Nonprofit Manager
• Implemented the ability to post / schedule a post with a "donate button" from Meta Business Suite.
positions.insights: Skills: Mercurial · GraphQL · ReasonML · Git · PHP · React · CSS · Front-End Development · flow

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Collaborator on the "Admin Money" team at Kueski Pay (Mexican Fintech in Buy now, pay later) as a frontend software engineer (React, Typescript, SASS, Storybook) improving the UX, fixing bugs, and adding new features to the customer portal where the clients see their purchases, payment methods and new opportunities.

• Helped with the creation of a new payment flow with Direct Debit (allowing clients to pay using its own debit card).
• Helped with the creation of a new purchase method with Virtual Card (new feature that would allow clients to create a single use virtual card to buy on any online store using Kueski).
• Implemented a redesign of the main page of the site, where the users will see the due payments and status of their purchases.
• Implemented a new navigation bar for mobile and desktop for the whole app. 
• Lead the internal program to move to flutter web by starting an intro to flutter course.
positions.insights: Skills: cypress · Git · React · CSS · JavaScript · Front-End Development · Flutter · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer, Intern
positions.description:
Collaborator on "Conversational Commerce" team (JavaScript; React Native, Hack).

• Improved Messenger Orders product by adding images to orders; and showing the as buyer/seller in mobile and web platforms
• Enhance the Order Details screen on mobile and web

positions.title: Software Engineer and Data science, Intern
positions.description:
Collaborator on "Azure Data ORCAS Differentiation" team (Python and SQL).

• Researched about the SOTA (State of the Art) in Text2SQL: Transforming natural language question into SQL
• Investigated intro adding OFFSET to SmBop
• Automatically creating SQL by grammar expansion

positions.title: Software Engineer, Intern
positions.description:
Collaborator on "Games Machine Learning" team (JavaScript; GraphQL, Hack, Python, and SQL).

• Improved the chaining experience on fb.gg thanks to A/B testing on the architecture that generates the "Up Next" videos.
• Enhance the recommendations at the endscreen of all gaming videos and the logging system used all over facebook.com/gaming.

positions.title: Software Product Sprint, Participant
positions.description:
Virtual, invite only program that brings together top university students across North America and Googlers for 11 weeks to design and build web apps, gain applied data structure and algorithms skills, and receive tailored career development resources

Implemented a Fudge Ratio calculator, which seeks to improve user productivity by changing scheduling habits:
• Worked especially on the front end of the application through designing and implementing responsive desktop and mobile UIs. 
• Followed industry best practices such as: contributing to open source software using git and Github, conducting code reviews and participating in distributed development.
• Worked on improving the backend of the project using various Google Cloud Platform APIs, including App Engine and DataStore.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Intern
positions.description:
Collaborator on "Search @ Messenger" team (JavaScript and ReasonML; Hack and GraphQL). Features are used by tens of millions of users each week.

• Created a better search experience by adding the ability to search for messages from the general search bar on messenger web.
• Collaborated with other 2 teams to improve navigation through different screens on messenger web following the M4 redesign.

positions.title: Founder and writer
positions.description:
My personal education project: math, algorithms and computer science.

Blog: Creator of a blog (in spanish) about discrete math, physics, vectorial analysis, algorithms and data structures, automata theory, intro to C and to POO using Java. The blog has around 350 000 views since the beginning of 2018.
https://compilandoconocimiento.com/

Books: Author of 6 books in Spanish about the bases of number theory, complex analysis, discrete math, statistics, linear algebra and an intro to relational databases which have been downloaded around 9,000 times.

Reference: Author of a competitive programming reference website
https://compilandoconocimiento.github.io/Reference/

positions.title: Web Maintainer, Intern
positions.description: Rewrote the student's website (profile, schedules, process to enroll) using PHP; redesigned it with the material design guidelines leading to a better and more intuitive user experience measured by a reduction (~30%) of confused students at the beginning of the semester.

I am the auxiliary teacher for the basic class and the person in charge of the prebasic course we do as an organization each semester.

You can learn more at: https://www.facebook.com/algoritmiaescom

You can learn more at: https://www.facebook.com/DWESCOM
